acceptanceCriteria.ac: Edit form accessible from placement card/profile - Button navigates to /daep/placements/[id]/edit
Editable fields: days_assigned, assigned_room_id, intake_notes, completion_notes, offense_code, placement_reason
Days recalculated on days_assigned change - Expected end date updates using calculateExpectedEndDate()
Room assignment validates separation constraints - Error shown when room contains separated student
Status transition buttons based on current state - Only valid transitions shown per state machine
All changes logged to audit trail - Audit entries created via logAuditEvent()
Validation prevents invalid data - Form shows Zod schema validation errors
Cancel returns to profile without saving - No changes persisted on cancel

constraints.constraint: All queries MUST use tenant_id = getTenantId() for multi-tenant isolation. Import from @/lib/tenant, NOT from Clerk publicMetadata.
Authorized roles: daep_admin_l1, daep_admin_l2, district_admin, super_admin. Note: master_admin was renamed to super_admin in migration 20251126200000.
Always validate transitions via isValidTransition() before updating status. Valid flow: pending → active → met → complete
All mutations MUST be logged via logAuditEvent() with eventType, module, actorId, targetId, action, details.
Edit form load: less than 500ms. Save operation: less than 1s.
Never hardcode colors. Use theme variables (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, etc.).
